extracted.name: Thyme Garlic Chicken
extracted.description: My own version of a recipe i saw on facebook 😅
ingredient_lines: 1 large can mushroom pieces and stems
instruction_lines: Season chicken generously with salt, pepper, and dried thmye
Add olive oil to a pan and put on medium low heat. Fry chicken skin side first.
Allow chicken to cook through and remove from heat. Reduce oil in the pan and add mushrooms. Cook until brown
Add onions and garlic. Cover pot and allow steam to build.
After 5 mins, add chicken broth and cube. Mix well and bring to a simmer,
Add chicken on top and do not stir. Cover pot until chicken is cooked and vegetables begin to dissolve.
Remove chicken to mix in all purpose cream. Stir until thick.
Serve with rice and garnish with some dried parsley.
